correctness.rationale: Exact inclusion-exclusion identity; uniform convergence of the 2-adic falling-factorial series and its difference quotient using j!(r-1-j)! divisibility; derivative congruences yield exact isometry on odd indices and scaled isometry on indices divisible by four; finite-level injection plus equal source/target cardinality proves surjectivity. Full residue image follows from parity decomposition and even-index mod8 obstruction. Standard-library verification checks every residue class k<=12 and 10,144 pairs.

value.rationale: Determining the exact attainable residue set for all powers of two and its Haar measure is a natural unsolved-in-inspected-text value-image invariant of the derangement sequence. The two isometric branches exhibit a structural separation between parity classes, not derivable from valuations alone; a genuine complete classification, not a small finite census.
